ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes feature large, contiguous white pigmentation. Dense dark pigmentation is concentrated along the leading edges and around the central peduncle area. Numerous high-contrast dark circular blobs (mottling) are scattered throughout the white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (1-10 pixels) along the entire trailing boundary. A significant, larger-scale jagged indentation is visible on the distal portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a complex curve, starting convexly near the notch and transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of localized, dark circular pixel clusters (resembling barnacle scars) are distributed across the white regions of both lobes, ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, irregular jagged notch or traumatic indentation is located on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific density and spatial arrangement of the dark circular 'ring-like' spots within the white pigmentation on the left lobe provide a unique fingerprint-like marker.
